transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I wanted to get us together to discuss the Civics Now digital curriculum pilot we're planning for the fall term. As you know, this will be a six-week pilot, and the draft implementation plan currently has 240 students enrolled with access through a public-facing curriculum webpage. The launch is scheduled for August 20, with one teacher-training session planned. Before I can sign off on this, we need to go through the implementation review process, so I'd like to hear from our instructional coach and librarian about any concerns or suggestions they have.

The pilot actually requires exactly two full teacher-training sessions — on August 12 and August 14 — before launch, not just one. Since both sessions must be completed before the pilot launches, the launch date needs to move from August 20 to August 26. I haven't yet entered this survey result into the pilot plan, but we need to update both the training schedule and the launch date before this plan is finalized.
